description: Inspect external-engine health and exact platform download sizes, save declined choices, or install selected Opengrep/Gitleaks/Trivy/OSV-Scanner components after explicit confirmation. Pass path (the repository to scan) to plan or install only the OSV vulnerability databases for the ecosystems its lockfiles use (and GitHub Actions advisories when it has workflows); each is listed with an estimated size (integrity: TLS + recorded SHA-256, OSV publishes no signature), and osv_ecosystems pins the exact list the user approved. Plan is offline. Install writes only to ~/.codeinspectus, verifies immutable pins/publisher provenance for engines, and never modifies the target repository.

action.description: Plan is offline/read-only. Install downloads only after confirm_downloads=true. Decline saves the choice.

components.description: Components to install or decline. Default: all four external engines.

confirm_downloads.description: Must be true for an install that needs network downloads.

osv_ecosystems.description: Exact OSV ecosystem databases the user approved, e.g. ["npm", "PyPI"]. Overrides the detection from path. Omitted or empty (an empty list is no list): the databases path needs (none without path), plus a refresh of any installed database that went stale. To download no OSV database, leave osv-scanner out of components.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository the user wants to scan. Only the OSV vulnerability databases for ecosystems whose lockfiles are found there (read-only, by file name) are offered.

name: codeinspectus_setup
title: Plan or install external security engines
